title: regional-kv-pause-and-softbackoff-guard-hotfix
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Summary: Hotfix to reduce region-wide KV eviction storms that were causing transient SLO breaches during metadata-thrashing incidents. Root cause: under high regional egress the KV sticky-preserve heuristic allowed aggressive KV retention eviction loops that amplified load; eviction churn caused higher CPU on the serving runtime and led to regional retry storms. This PR introduces a defensive 'regional KV pause' gate and an exponential soft-backoff for sticky eviction decisions, plus extra telemetry and an emergency runbook link. Motivation and context: after incident SUP-9012 on 2026-02-18 we observed repeated reopen cycles tied to KV pressure; prior mitigations (short-term drain) prevented immediate outage but did not stop churn. The fix is intentionally conservative and primarily runtime-side so it can be backported to release branches. Changes in this PR: 1) runtime/eviction.go: introduce RegionKVPauseManager (lightweight gate) that rate-limits eviction churn for nodes within the same region and enforces a short circuit that prefers soft-eviction (drop non-hot prefixes) before full tenant eviction; 2) runtime/eviction_policy.go: add exponential soft-backoff state machine for sticky-preserve toggles (max backoff 30s with jitter); 3) controller/region_probe.go: expose a probe that surfaces kv_pressure_ratio and kv_eviction_churn metrics and a new API endpoint used by the control plane to annotate affected nodes; 4) telemetry/metrics.yaml: add kv_eviction_churn, kv_pause_events, kv_backoff_state metrics and Grafana dashboard fragment; 5) tests/regression_kv_shedding_test.go: deterministic regression that reproduces the pressure->churn loop and validates the pause/backoff suppresses oscillation; 6) docs/runbooks.md: emergency runbook entry "Regional KV pause and soft-backoff" and rollback instructions. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced churn in local benchmark harness - [x] Unit tests added and passing - [x] Integration scenario validated in benchlab (staging) - [x] Runbook written and reviewed - [x] Backport PRs prepared for release/2026-02-hotfix Notes on design tradeoffs: the RegionKVPauseManager is intentionally coarse-grained (region-level) to avoid per-tenant state bloat; we chose a soft-eviction-first approach to preserve hot KV prefixes whenever possible. This reduces tail-latency regressions at the cost of slightly longer memory residency for low-activity prefixes during the pause window. Follow-ups: - Consider adaptive backoff bounds driven by observed CPU/egress signals (ENG-4290) - Add per-tenant telemetry tagging for disputed prefixes (work item ENG-4354) Links: Incident SUP-9012 heatmap: https://redwood.internal/incidents/SUP-9012; Linear tasks: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4281.
commits: fix(runtime): add region kv pause manager and pause state machine
feat(eviction): exponential soft-backoff for sticky-preserve toggles
test(bench): add regression that reproduces kv churn and verifies suppression
docs: runbook entry for regional-kv-pause and rollback steps
chore(telemetry): add kv_eviction_churn and kv_pause_events metrics
review_comments: Ethan Zhang: Please clarify lifecycle of the pause token—what ensures it doesn't remain sticky across long partitions?; Priya: The pause token is tied to a TTL (default 30s) and persisted only in-memory on each region coordinator; we intentionally avoid cross-region persistence to prevent split-brain persistence.
Maya Cortez: Can we gate the default max backoff to an operator-configurable value?; Priya: Added operator flag --kv-backoff-max and documented in ops/flags.md; default remains 30s.

Oliver Schmidt: Observability looks good, but add an indicator metric for 'eviction_suppressed_count' so we can alert on persistent suppression; Priya: added kv_pause_events and eviction_suppressed_count in metrics.yaml and dashboard fragment.
release_notes: Hotfix: Introduced regional KV pause gate and exponential soft-backoff for sticky eviction to prevent eviction-churn storms and reduce SLO breaches under heavy regional egress. Added telemetry and runbook. Backported to release/2026-02-hotfix.
notes_for_ops: Backport PRs: release/2026-02-hotfix already prepared. Operator flag --kv-backoff-max (default 30s) and --kv-pause-threshold (default 0.75 kv_pressure_ratio) introduced. If incidents recur, escalate to runtime on-call and follow runbook section 'regional-kv-pause' to force-disable via control-plane annotation.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: soft-backoff may increase memory residency for cold prefixes leading to temporary memory pressure on small nodes. Mitigation: pause is region-scoped and limited by TTL; we have a fail-open path that will revert to previous hard-eviction behavior if node memory exceeds emergency threshold (configured via --kv-emergency-memory-percent).
post_merge_actions: 1) Cherry-pick to release/2026-02-hotfix and 2026-01-maintenance branches (done). 2) Monitor kv_eviction_churn and eviction_suppressed_count dashboards for 72 hours. 3) If suppression rate exceeds threshold, revert via admin flag --kv-pause-enabled=false and open ENG follow-up.
